# 公民與社會 / Civics and Society: course outline

**Version 1, 2026-11-28.** 6 parts, 19 chapters, about 9.5 hours of lessons.  
Core: 0 parts, 0 chapters. Tracks: sprint-116.  
Papers: social. Paths: 社會 (`social`). Status: planned.

## Decisions

- 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required subject in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
- Owner (2026-11-28): the 社會 sprint has about 57 chapters (歷史 15, 地理 20, 公民 19, 社會綜合 3), at most 5 codes per 30-minute chapter as in the science sprint.
- Owner (2026-11-28): one subject at a time in the order 地理 → 公民 → 歷史, then the shared 社會綜合 part (social.json).
- Owner (2026-11-28): no new components for the sprint. Sources and statutes are quoted blocks with provenance and an as-of date, attributed readings use Perspective, maps are schematic Graph drawings labelled 示意圖, time-sensitive values use Fact, and drawing items are rubric self-checks.
- Teaching order follows research/verified-2026-11-15.json final_units; every official dependsOn edge between covered codes is respected.
- Practice items are original and only modelled on the 111–115 papers; official papers are linked, never copied.
- Economics runs micro then macro (Bl → Bm → Bn → Bo → Ce → Cf/Cg → Bq), and 勞動參與 (Cd) comes after Ce, Cf and Cg, as the verification corrected (design 03 §3.1).
- Current legal terms throughout: 最低工資 (not 基本工資) and 憲法法庭判決 (not 釋字) (TS-14).
- On exam day the pre-amendment 民法§1223 (特留分) applies; the 115-08-17 amendment takes effect about mid-February 2027 (TS-11).
- 延伸探究 material appears only in boxes labelled 「情境素材，非測驗知識」 (考試說明).

## Open questions

1. TS-13: facts.json already gives the 2027 minimum wage (NT$30,900 / NT$205 from 2027-01-01), but the research marks explicit 行政院 approval as not seen. Research is frozen, so this can't be re-checked here: keep, or show both rates with the as-of note?
2. TS-10 (最低工資法 in-force date), TS-11 (exact §1223 in-force date), TS-3 (contents of the 選罷法 amendments) and TS-4 (2022 修憲複決 figures, secondary source) are open in the research; chapters avoid stating them or mark them unverified.
3. TS-12: 114年憲判字第1號 and the 憲法訴訟法 quorum amendment are a live dispute; s116-law-constitution-rights presents dates from primary sources and the dispute as attributed, dated and unsettled.
4. sources.json has no entry yet for 刑法, 憲法訴訟法, the 民法 property and inheritance articles, 行政程序法 or 原住民族基本法. They are added in the civics batch from URLs in the research only (law.moj pcodes), or the chapter cites the guideline instead.
5. History/civics 考試說明 例題 numbers come from the older 108年9月 file (design 03 §0.4); they can't be re-checked against the 108.11.08 file without new research.
6. Exam-item links (examItems) and reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2.
